name: vllm-rocm-halo-main-wheel
description: vLLM upstream main wheel built from source on the ROCm 7.13 / gfx1151 base, packaged as a FROM-scratch image (the .whl + resolved rocm requirements only). Compiled incrementally via a persistent ccache BuildKit cache mount. Consumed by the vllm-rocm-halo-main assembler to produce clean nightly images in ~2 min without recompiling. ABI-locked to (VLLM_TAG, VLLM_BASE, gfx1151, py3.13); rebuild when upstream main or the base image changes.
